University of Kashmir, Hazratbal Srinagar-190 006.
Interview notice
Please be informed that the interview for the position of Semi-
Skilled labour under the JKSTIC sponsored research project
entitled "Utilization of polysaccharides and Chinar leaves for
designing of hydrogels as a sustainable irrigation system for
high-density apple orchard plants..." , implemented by
the Department of Food Science and Technology, University
of Kashmir,will be held on 23.06.2026 (Tuesday) from 11:00
AM onwards in the Department of Food Science & Technology.
Applicants are required to bring all relevant documents in
original and as photocopies.
Sd/-
Dr. Adil Gani
Principal Investigator
